thread:
ashley: Heads-up: baby arrived early, moving my parental leave up by 10 days. We have two sprints of frontend work I can
oc and hand off but we might need short-term help. Any special funds?

omar: Congrats! We have Emergency Family Support (reimburse up to $1k/mo) and a Short-Term Backfill Loan (interest-free, up to $5k). Which are you thinking?

ashley: Likely a 3-week contractor estimate $2.5k. Would loan be required?

omar: Yes loan fits that size. Process: manager approval email to people-ops, fill STB loan form, payroll sets deductions (default 6 months). If >$3k finance review required; your case $2.5k stays in People Ops.

joy: As manager I approve. I'll email people-ops with cost, dates, and a 1-page handoff doc.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: After approval submit signed agreement to payroll@redwood.com with code STB-LOAN. Payroll will confirm deduction schedule.

ashley: Appreciate the quick help. Will attach handoff and contractor rate in the email.

omar: Quick note: eligibility requires active employment and 30+ days tenure. Keep the email private; People Ops handles confidential info.

ashley: Thanks all. Will post update when approval comes through. :heart:
